rows.label: PERVERSION

rows.label: ZIGZAG

rows.label: CULMINATION
rows.clue: A final climactic stage

rows.label: BOBOLINK

rows.label: LETTER STOCK

rows.label: FIRE CODE

rows.label: EASING

rows.label: AIR BAG
rows.clue: A safety restraint in an automobile

rows.label: GHERKIN
rows.clue: Any of various small cucumbers pickled whole

rows.label: SERVICE CLUB
rows.clue: A club of professional or business people organized for their coordination and active in public services

rows.label: MEMORIZATION
rows.clue: Learning so as to be able to remember verbatim

rows.label: OPTICAL GLASS
rows.clue: Clear homogeneous glass of known refractive index

rows.label: ICE FOG
rows.clue: A dense winter fog containing ice particles

rows.label: HIGHLAND
rows.clue: Elevated (e.g., mountainous) land

rows.label: SEVENTY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and seven

rows.label: PARK
rows.clue: A large area of land preserved in its natural state as public property

rows.label: CORAL FUNGUS
rows.clue: Any of numerous fungi of the family Clavariaceae often brightly colored that grow in often intricately branched clusters like coral

rows.label: QUIETNESS
rows.clue: The property of making no sound

rows.label: RIM
rows.clue: The shape of a raised edge of a more or less circular object

rows.label: ERA
rows.clue: A period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event

rows.label: TRY
rows.clue: Earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something

rows.label: AARDVARK
rows.clue: Nocturnal burrowing mammal of the grasslands of Africa that feeds on termites

rows.label: QUICK BUCK
rows.clue: Quick or easy earnings, "they are traders out to make a fast buck"

rows.label: PARADOX
rows.clue: (logic) a statement that contradicts itself

rows.label: FAINT
rows.clue: A spontaneous loss of consciousness caused by insufficient blood to the brain

rows.label: CLIMBING FRAME
rows.clue: A framework of bars or logs for children to climb on

rows.label: BACON RIND
rows.clue: The rind of bacon

rows.label: YEOMANRY

rows.label: LEARNING
rows.clue: The cognitive process of acquiring skill or knowledge

rows.label: FUMIGANT
rows.clue: A chemical substance used in fumigation

rows.label: DOWNDRAFT

rows.label: REMAINS

rows.label: RATIONAL
